note: MyDesk Surface provides a partial precision NURBS surfacing, continuity, and diagnostic implementation targeting Autodesk Alias. FUNCTIONAL entries cover only their tested subsets and do not imply complete Class-A or Alias parity.

capabilities.name: NURBS cubic spline evaluation and derivative computation
capabilities.reference_behavior: Evaluate coordinates and derivatives of arbitrary degree NURBS curves via Cox-de Boor algorithm.
capabilities.expected_input: Control points, degree, and knot vector
capabilities.expected_output: Exact spatial position and curvature evaluation
capabilities.differences: Cox-de Boor cubic spline evaluation verified.

capabilities.name: Interactive curvature comb visualization vectors
capabilities.reference_behavior: Generate normal-projected curvature vectors along curve domain proportional to local curvature radius.
capabilities.expected_input: Curve handle, sample density, and scale

capabilities.name: NURBS tensor-product surface evaluation and normal calculation
capabilities.reference_behavior: Evaluate bi-parametric S(u,v) surfaces and compute exact unit surface normals.
capabilities.expected_input: Control vertex grid, knots U, knots V
capabilities.expected_output: Point coordinates and surface normal vector
capabilities.differences: Rational tensor-product evaluation and analytical first/second derivatives are verified for the supported patches; trimming, intersections, degree editing, and surface rebuilding remain incomplete.

capabilities.name: Gaussian and Mean curvature evaluation via fundamental forms
capabilities.reference_behavior: Compute first and second fundamental forms to calculate exact Gaussian K and Mean H curvatures.
capabilities.expected_output: Gaussian K and Mean H curvature scalar values
capabilities.differences: Gaussian and mean curvature use analytical rational NURBS derivatives and are verified on planar and parabolic cases; broader reference-surface validation remains incomplete.

capabilities.name: G0/G1/G2 seam diagnostics and control-net alignment
capabilities.reference_behavior: Measure positional, tangent, and curvature continuity across adjacent patches and align editable control nets to a requested order with undo and redo.
capabilities.expected_output: Tolerance report with gap, angular, and normal-curvature deviation plus reversible G0/G1/G2 alignment
capabilities.differences: Sampled G0/G1/G2 diagnostics and parameter-domain-scaled control-net alignment are verified for adjacent non-rational bicubic Bezier patches; arbitrary NURBS patch matching, topology-aware edge selection, and higher orders remain incomplete.

capabilities.name: Zebra reflection line surface quality simulation
capabilities.reference_behavior: Simulate parallel light stripe reflections on shiny Class-A surfaces to expose curvature discontinuities.

capabilities.name: Native project serialization and round-trip
capabilities.reference_behavior: Save and load native .mysurface files preserving NURBS curves, surfaces, and metadata.
capabilities.performance: In-memory schema-v2 structural serialization with atomic desktop file replacement
capabilities.differences: Schema-v2 loading validates and restores curve/surface IDs, degrees, knots, weights, control points, and control grids. The Qt workflow uses atomic QSaveFile replacement and is round-trip tested; migration from all historical variants, unknown-field preservation, autosave, and crash recovery remain incomplete.

capabilities.name: Persistent interactive NURBS surfacing workspace
capabilities.command: CREATE / OBJECT EDIT / CV EDIT / VIEW / UNDO / REDO
capabilities.reference_behavior: Provide a persistent industrial-surfacing desktop workspace with surface hierarchy, editable control vertices, diagnostic 3D navigation, continuity tools, document history, and native project file workflows.
capabilities.expected_input: Interactive curve and surface creation, browser selection, control-vertex values, viewport gestures, seam selections, and native document paths
capabilities.expected_output: Engine-backed geometry edits shown in a navigable tessellated viewport and preserved through undo, redo, save, and reopen
manual_tests: Orbit, pan, zoom, select a patch and control vertex, then inspect curvature and zebra diagnostics
capabilities.performance: Interactive CPU sampling for the small and medium patch sets covered by current tests
capabilities.differences: The UI is a substantive engine-backed surfacing workspace, but not Alias parity. It lacks GPU/production tessellation, arbitrary topology and trimming, modeling manipulators, construction history, layered scene organization, advanced diagnostic families, production rendering, and conforming CAD exchange.
